verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://www.librechat.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and describes itself as a "Curated map of the LibreChat documentation for language models and coding agents." Docs pages are also served as raw markdown (docs.md and per-page .md URLs), and a machine-readable openapi.json is published, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually use these docs effectively.
